title: On the Convergence of HalpernSGD
summary: We study HalpernSGD for minimizing a convex Fréchet differentiable function with Lipschitz gradient on a real Hilbert space. Its deterministic orbit converges strongly to the anchor-selected minimizer \(P_S(u)\) under vanishing steps that need not be square summable. For stochastic oracles, weighted summability of the scaled martingale fluctuation and the \(\F_n\)-measurable bias yields almost sure strong convergence, while expected last-iterate bounds require suffix regularity of the error budget.
